prompt: Implement uniform crossover, where a seeded coin flip chooses which parent contributes each position, plus the mask that records those flips. Complete the mask and cross methods in the starter file.
explanation: Uniform crossover flips one coin per position instead of cutting the genome once, so it mixes parents far more aggressively and does not favour genes that happen to sit near each other. Because mask and cross both start a fresh Random from the same seed and call nextBoolean the same number of times in the same order, the mask is an exact record of what cross did -- a handy debugging trick for any seeded algorithm. Checking the lengths first turns a confusing StringIndexOutOfBoundsException into a clear error.
hints: A StringBuilder is the natural accumulator here; append one character per position.
rng.nextBoolean() == true means take from parent a and false means parent b -- keep that order identical in both methods.
Validate a.length() == b.length() before the loop and throw IllegalArgumentException if it fails.
